messages:
maria.docs: opened a small PR to tighten SOC2 audit log wording + examples: https://git.company/repos/docs/pulls/842
vikram.security: linking it now. what's the core change?
maria.docs: clarifies pseudonymization behavior for tenant/user ids, adds curl + go SDK snippets, and a short section on how to request full redaction for sensitive customers
angelo.devex: quick catch  the retention matrix link in the draft points to the old path and 404s. I can update it to /docs/retention/matrix-v2.md
maria.docs: please do, thanks. also drafting a sentence: "By default Redwood pseudonymizes tenant and user identifiers in operational audit events; customers can request redaction through Tenant Settings." thoughts?
vikram.security: tweak: "By default, Redwood pseudonymizes user and tenant identifiers in operational audit events. Customers requiring irreversible de-identification may request redaction via Tenant Settings (legal approval required). See the retention matrix for per-region defaults and legal-hold behavior."
sophie.legal: +1 to the legal approval note. also add parenthetical: "redaction requests may be subject to lawful process and retention obligations."
maria.docs: updated wording in the PR
angelo.devex: added two tiny examples for the snippets section. sharing inline:

maria.docs: good, paste them please
angelo.devex: 
```
# curl example (audit producer)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/events \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"event_type":"user.login","tenant_pseudonym":"t-xyz123","meta":{"ip":"1.2.3.4"}}'

// go example (internal SDK)
client.Audit().WriteEvent(ctx, AuditEvent{
  Type: "user.login",
  TenantPseudonym: "t-xyz123",
  Meta: map[string]string{"ip":"1.2.3.4"},
})
```

angelo.devex: shows `tenant_pseudonym` field and that metadata is optional. no real tokens used
vikram.security: include a short example for the redaction request flow, mark it async and legal-approved. suggestion:

```
POST /v1/tenant/:id/redact
Body: {"scope":"audit_events","since":"2023-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
Response: 202 Accepted
```

vikram.security: ops note: redaction will irreversibly de-identify tenant identifiers in indexed fields but an internal hashed audit reference is retained for compliance and tracing
sophie.legal: prefer 'irreversibly de-identify' phrasing instead of 'remove identifiers'  thanks
maria.docs: applied changes, switched in-line field names to backticks for rendering, fixed retention link to matrix-v2
ci-bot: CI: docs lint passed (commit a3b7c9). build #1210
maria.docs: would you both give a final thumbs so I can merge?
vikram.security: :thumbsup:
sophie.legal: :white_check_mark:
maria.docs: merged. I'll add a one-line changelog for the docs release notes and a short follow-up note in the compliance checklist. thanks everyone! :tada:
